data.one_liner: Read and write audio file metadata across multiple formats.
data.what_it_does: Allows reading and writing tags such as title, artist, album, genre, year, track numbers, and embedded pictures in audio files. It uses a Rust backend to support multiple audio formats.
use_when: You need to read or update audio tags (ID3, etc.) directly in files.
You are building a music player or file manager that needs to display track metadata and embedded cover art.
avoid_when: You only need to stream or play audio without modifying its tags.
You are targeting web platform (not supported by this plugin).
strengths: Supports multiple audio formats via the lofty Rust crate.
Provides methods for both reading and writing metadata.
weaknesses: Relies on FFI and Rust components which may add build complexity.
data.setup_notes: Relies on flutter_rust_bridge and FFI; standard plugin installation applies for supported platforms (android, ios, windows, macos, linux).
